claim: Entry-only checks of a patched routine miss loops that branch into displaced bytes; keep small whole loops in immutable trampolines or put the patch ahead of every back edge, and check through return.

evidence.text: Keep small whole loops in immutable trampolines, or move the patch ahead of every back edge; check original and patched routines through return and run the native room.
In the fast C replay an interior of a patched entry hit once means an interrupt between its first instructions.
The verifier must permit reached displaced interiors, not arbitrary interior jumps.
A game may call inside a routine: the gold's XOR enters 0x984A, not 0x983E; the tile model in verify found it at the first gold.
